transcript: Detox your entire body through the pores of your feet. Here is what you must do. Soak your feet in five simple ingredients for 20 minutes. Your feet have over 7,000 nerve endings and the largest pores on your body. That makes them a direct gateway to your lymphatic system. Your body's garbage truck that hauls the waste out. But most people's lymphatic system is barely moving. Years of processed food, poor sleep and chronic stress have turned that garbage truck into a parking lot. When your lymph stops moving, the toxins stay. They sit in your tissues, your joints, your organs. That is why you wake up puffy, why your joints ache, why your brain feels like fog, why you feel exhausted no matter how much you sleep. Here is the recipe. Step 1. Hot water, as hot as you can handle. The heat opens the pores and forces the lymph to move. Step 2. One cup of Epsom salt. The magnesium pulls out heavy metals and lets your muscles finally relax. Step 3. Two tablespoons of baking soda to balance your skin's pH. Step 4. A quarter cup of lemon juice to break up uric acid and kick lymphatic drainage into gear. Step 5. 5 to 10 drops of essential oil. Rosemary for lymph movement, peppermint for circulation, or lavender for nervous system healing. Soak for 20 to 30 minutes. Here is the key most people miss. When you finish, elevate your feet to help the lymph flow upward and out. You will notice better sleep, less brain fog, and a calm you are not expecting. In Chinese medicine, we have used foot soaking to draw out toxins for thousands of years. But your lymphatic system did not shut down just because of bad food. It shut down because of how you live. Chronic stress paralyzes your lymph. Anxiety tightens every muscle that should be pumping it through. The motions you never release sit in your tissues like poison. The foot soak gets things moving tonight. But if tomorrow you go back to the same stress, your lymph slows right back down. Write in the comments detox. If you are going to try this tonight, and if you want to learn how to keep your body clean from the inside every day, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that.
